summary: Comprehensive testing of Calendly webhook cancellation tracking and Admin Dashboard. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with Playwright - stats cards, status badges, and filters all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper separation of concerns
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded from API responses
Revenue calculation correctly excludes canceled bookings
Status badges use appropriate color coding (green for confirmed, red for canceled)
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for bookings (both confirmed and canceled)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendly webhook integration fully tested. Test data with TEST_ prefix exists in database. Admin auth uses in-memory token storage (MVP approach). All cancellation tracking features verified working.

features_verified.calendly_webhook_invitee_canceled: PASS - Updates booking status to 'canceled', stores cancellation_reason and canceled_at
features_verified.admin_dashboard_stats: PASS - Shows Total Bookings, Confirmed (green), Canceled (red), Total Revenue
features_verified.admin_dashboard_revenue_calculation: PASS - Revenue only includes confirmed bookings (€150 from 1 confirmed, excludes €500 from 2 canceled)
features_verified.admin_dashboard_status_badges: PASS - Green badge for confirmed, red badge for canceled
features_verified.admin_authentication: PASS - Login/logout working with token-based auth

mocked_apis.note: Calendly webhooks are MOCKED via curl POST requests for testing. In production, webhooks will come from Calendly servers.
